## What's Changed
* Update dependency vite to v8.3.6 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/640
* Use colour-coded labels on the Runs page by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/639
* Render markdown in human task description in the Inbox by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/642
* Update softprops/action-gh-release digest to 8a0cd65 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/660
* Update dependency org.codehaus.mojo:build-helper-maven-plugin to v3.7.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/661
* Filter runs by workflow when clicking the Workflow column by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/662
* Add This Month filter to AI usage page by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/663
* Update dependency io.smallrye:jandex-maven-plugin to v3.6.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/664
* Update dependency @vitejs/plugin-react to v6.3.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/667
* Update quarkus.platform.version to v3.40.1.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/666
* Update dependency vite to v8.3.7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/665
* Update dependency org.codehaus.mojo:build-helper-maven-plugin to v3.8.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/668
* Update dependency @testing-library/user-event to v14.6.9 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/669
* Add expiration dates to secrets by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/670
* Configure the Jira email separately and verify Jira credentials before polling by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/671


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/compare/v3.0.4...v3.0.5
